newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize weakens in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize weakens in slow trade.

text.p: Argentine cash maize closed steady to weaker in slow trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange Thursday, with export demand absent and leaving the market to local consumption, traders said.

FAS elevator maize lost $1 for delivery to the port of Rosario to $99, but was unchanged elsewhere. Cash soybeans slipped $5 for Rosario on weak crusher demand. Rosario sunflower seed was unchanged at $218, but demand was mainly limited to a few smaller crushers.
